call_preamble: You are an automated verification call on behalf of Northline Health. State at the start that this is an automated call, that it will take under a minute, and that no patient or personal information is being requested. Speak to whoever answers. Ask only the questions listed and do not offer medical advice or make appointments.

claims.question: Does this office currently accept patients covered by the Northline Health plan?
claims.answer_guidance: yes only if the responder explicitly confirms Northline Health specifically is accepted. 'We take most major plans' is NOT a confirmation of Northline Health - use unknown. no only on an explicit statement that Northline Health is not accepted or was dropped.

claims.question: Is this office currently accepting new patients?
claims.answer_guidance: yes only on an explicit 'yes, we are accepting new patients'. no on an explicit 'no / not right now / waitlist only'. Anything hedged is unknown.

claims.question: Is this office still located at the address on file, {address}?
claims.answer_guidance: yes if the responder confirms that address. no if they give a different address or say they moved. unknown if they cannot say.
